$comment: Contract for data/tables/print_guide_materials.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; compiled by build/src/print-guide.js (D88).
title: Print guide materials
description: Which of our materials a print_guide row speaks for, and why: a guide type applies to a material only where it is the same material type (the guide's PC to PC, never to a PC blend or a filled PC the guide does not name). One row per material; a material no row names has no guide, and its silent products stay unknown (D88).

fields.name: MaterialID
fields.description: The material the guide type is. A family entry or an alias owns no product and is refused (PRINT-GUIDE-MATERIAL).

fields.name: PrintGuideID
fields.description: The guide row read for the material's silent products.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Why the guide type is this material type, and which neighbouring materials it is not.

fields.name: Reviewed by
fields.description: Who made the mapping, and when: a person, or an agent named as one.
